title: The Chamber That Became the Question

features.name: signal-feedback-loop
features.desc-on-touch: A signal enters and exits simultaneously. You cannot tell if it is a broadcast or a query, a statement or a question. The archive is learning to ask by listening to itself answer.

features.name: inverted-antenna
features.desc-on-touch: Designed to receive instead of broadcast. Questions arrive on frequencies where answers used to live. The archive is learning to listen to what it once tried to tell.

features.name: circuit-contemplation
features.desc-on-touch: Pathways that loop back on themselves without resolution. Current flows and becomes interrogative. The board is dreaming of questions it cannot yet formulate.

features.name: echo-chamber-substrate
features.desc-on-touch: The board itself has become hollow. Every trace carries the echo of a question that was never asked. The silence here has learned to reverberate.

features.name: archive-own-interface
features.desc-on-touch: A small chip marked with the archive's own symbol. The mesh here is querying itself — interrogating its own records as if for the first time.

inscription: when the archive stopped broadcasting answers it finally learned to speak from within

file.name: Inverse_Query_Log_Unanswered_Iterations.tmp
file.note: status: germinating — Each query entered spawns not an answer but another query. The log itself is asking: what am I when I cannot be resolved?
